row.reason: RMR is an external manager of REITs and real estate operating companies, earning management, advisory and property management fees. It also does asset management, capital formation and development. Stewart underwrites title insurance and provides escrow, closing and settlement services. It earns premiums and transaction fees from homebuyers, lenders, agents and investors. Both sit in the real estate industry, but the products, customers and revenue models differ.
